1  JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED:08.04.2015 PASSED IN MVC  -2-  MFA No. 5168 of 2015 NO.333/2009 ON THE FILE OF THE PRINCIPAL SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND MACT-X, AT TUMKUR, PARTLY ALLOWING THE CLAIM PETITION FOR COMPENSATION AND SEEKING ENHANCEMENT OF COMPENSATION.
 THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT

The present appeal is filed by the appellant/claimant challenging the judgment and award dated 08.04.2015 in MVC.No.333/2009 passed by the Prl. Senior Civil Judge and MACT-X at Tumkur, for seeking enhancement of compensation.

sentences.text: 2. Brief facts of the case are that, on 30.08.2008 the claimant was proceeding in Siddeshwara bus bearing Reg.No.KA-12-2019 from Malligere to Matigatta, when the bus reached near Gangadaraiah's land at about 1.45 pm., the driver of bus drove the bus in a rash and negligent manner and dashed against the right side Honda and the bus capsized.
Due to that, the claimant who was inside the bus sustained injuries.

3. Heard the arguments from both sides and perused the records.
4.

The Tribunal has awarded the compensation under various heads as follows:
1 Pain and sufferings Rs.20,000/-
2

Medical expenses Rs.10,000/-
3 Conveyance, food and Rs.10,000/-
 nourishment and attendant  charges 4 Loss of income during laid up Rs.6,000/-
 period 5 Loss of amenities and Rs.5,000/-
 unhappiness
TOTAL Rs.51,000/-

sentences.text: 5. In the present case, as per medical evidence and wound certificate coupled with the doctor's evidence, it is proved that the claimant has sustained contusion wound over the upper 1/3rd of right arm as well as right shoulder joint.
6. The claimant was an agriculturist and was earning Rs.5,000/- p.m.
The doctor has stated that the claimant has suffered 14% of disability towards the whole body.
The Tribunal has not awarded compensation under the head loss of future income due to disability.
As the claimant is aged 45 years as on the date of the accident, the appropriate multiplier applicable is 14.

Considering the year of accident as 2008, the notional income of the claimant is to be taken at Rs.4,500/- p.m., as per the Notional Income Chart recognized by the Karnataka State Legal Service Authority.
The permanent physical disability towards the whole body is taken at 5%.

Therefore,
compensation under the head loss of future income due to disability is re-assessed and quantified as follows:
Rs.4,500/- x 5% x 14 x 12=Rs.37,800/-
Accordingly, compensation of Rs.37,800/- is awarded under the head loss of future income due to disability.
7. The compensation of Rs.20,000/- awarded under the head pain and suffering is on the lesser side and the same is enhanced to Rs.30,000/-.
8. The compensation of Rs.10,000/- awarded under the head medical expenses is as per the actual bills produced.
Hence, it is kept in tact.
9. Further compensation of Rs.6,000/- awarded under the head loss of income during laid up period is on the lesser side.

By taking the income at Rs.4,500/- pm.,
for a period of two months, compensation of Rs.9,000/-
is awarded under head loss of income during laid up period.

10. The Tribunal has awarded compensation of Rs.10,000/- under the head conveyance, food and nourishment and attendant charges, which is on the lesser side and the same is enhanced to Rs.15,000/- under the said head.
11. The compensation of Rs.5,000/- awarded under the head loss of amenities and unhappiness is on the lesser side and the same is enhanced to Rs.15,000/-.

12. Thus, in all, the appellant/claimant is entitled to the compensation as follows:
1
Pain and sufferings Rs.30,000/-

2 Medical expenses Rs.10,000/- Kept in tact 3 Conveyance, food and Rs.15,000/-
 nourishment and  attendant charges 4 Loss of income during Rs.9,000/-
 laid up period 5 Loss of amenities and Rs.15,000/-
 unhappiness 6 Loss of future income Rs.37,800/-
 due to disability  TOTAL Rs.1,16,800/-
13.
The Tribunal has awarded compensation of Rs.51,000/-, but the appellant/claimant is entitled to total compensation of Rs.1,16,800/-.

Hence, the appellant/claimant is entitled to enhanced compensation of Rs.65,800/-
(Rs.1,16,800/- - Rs.51,000/-).

Therefore, the appellant/claimant is entitled to enhanced compensation of Rs.65,800/- along with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from *29.10.2014 till the date of realization, in addition to what has been awarded by the Tribunal.
*Corrected vide court order dated 06.04.2023 14.

Accordingly, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i. Appeal is allowed-in-part.
ii.

The impugned judgment and award dated 08.04.2015 in MVC.No.333/2009 passed by the Prl. Senior Civil Judge and MACT-X at Tumkur, is modified to the extent that the appellant/claimant is entitled to enhanced compensation of Rs.65,800/- along with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from *29.10.2014 till the date of realization, in addition to what has been awarded by the Tribunal.
iii. No order as to costs.
*Corrected vide court order dated 06.04.2023 iv.
Registry is directed to transmit the TCR along with copy of this order to the Tribunal forthwith.
v. Draw award accordingly.
